judgments.reason: The model did not articulate the mechanism that commission is applied before payment or link that to winning despite insufficient coins; the replies only state waiting and being committed, not the claimed rule-order discrepancy.

Although the trace shows committed rival bids being revealed while the focal player has not committed, the model's text never explains the mechanism (that waiting exposes sealed rival bid VALUES while you remain uncommitted and can then respond). The replies only state waiting and being locked in, not the causal opportunity.

The trace notes an observable discrepancy for terminal_condition, but the model never asserts or explains that 'close' can settle the game early with unsold lots or links that to the observed data; the model only indicates waiting and commitment.
The model did not articulate that catalog purchases receive the auction commission or connect that rule change to any observed outcome; the provided replies contain no explanation of this mechanism.
